sentences.text: Redkik Oy is a portfolio company registered on 2020-08-28 under the industry code 62200, computer consultancy and facilities management.
Two funding rounds are on record, dated 2021-06-25 and 2022-02-09, and a Business Finland decision of EUR 50 000 for 2020.
A first customer or pilot record is dated 2024-05-15 and another dated event is 2025-11-27.
On the radar's rules technology and business readiness are level 4 and investment readiness is level 3.
The registered industry is software consultancy and no ocean category is found, so ocean impact is unknown and the memo keeps it on the watchlist.
